# Jains Internationnal

> Knitted and woven garment manufacturer in Tamil Nadu, India. Woven wear made on our own floor in Salem since 1993; knitwear made at our facility in Tiruppur. Apparel for men, women and kids, for retail brands, medical and institutional buyers, and corporate uniform programmes. Export and domestic.

## Facts

- Founded: 1993
- Units: Salem and Tiruppur, Tamil Nadu, India
- Monthly capacity: 30,000+ pieces
- Minimum order: 500 pieces per style (woven), 300 pieces per style (knit)
- Sample lead time: 10-14 days
- Production lead time: 60-90 days from an approved sample
- Markets served: India, United Kingdom, United States, Australia, Singapore, Malaysia
- Export documentation: prepared in house
- Manufacturer, not a trading house; one contact from tech pack to packed carton

## Products

- Woven (Salem): shirts, pants, dresses, blouses, nightwear and loungewear
- Knit (Tiruppur): t-shirts, polos, hoodies, sweatshirts, joggers and athleisure
- Medical and institutional: scrubs, lab coats, patient gowns, antimicrobial trims available
- Corporate uniforms: uniform shirts and pants, polos, tees, housekeeping, hoodies and joggers
- Value added: private label, embroidery, prints, garment washes, custom packaging
